identity.name: Studio Practice
identity.intro: A selection of identities, printed matter, and visual experiments. Thoughtful work, from the first idea to the smallest detail.

about.title: A considered approach.
paragraphs: Studio Practice is a demonstration portfolio for independent creatives. Its projects explore the meeting point of clear ideas, expressive typography, and everyday objects.
Good work starts with a conversation. From a single printed piece to a complete visual identity, the aim is always the same: make something that feels right and works hard.

contact.note: Have a project in mind? Contact details will be available here soon.

seo.title: Studio Practice — Independent design
seo.description: A demonstration creative portfolio featuring visual identities, editorial design, and graphic experiments. Built to make your own.

projects.title: Field Notes
projects.summary: An identity for a slower way of seeing. Grounded in nature, built around a simple, expressive mark.

cover.alt: Field Notes identity study: a green botanical symbol on pale yellow

description: A self-initiated identity study about observation and the natural world. A leaf becomes a modular mark, used across a family of printed pieces.
A restricted palette and generous typography give the identity room to breathe. This is original demonstration artwork, ready to replace with your own project.

gallery.alt: Field Notes wordmark and modular leaf symbol
Two Field Notes editorial covers in forest green and pale yellow

projects.title: Common Ground
projects.summary: A publication about shared spaces. Bold letterforms, warm paper, and a different perspective on the familiar.

cover.alt: Common Ground editorial study in rust red and warm white

description: An experimental publication exploring the spaces we share. Large letterforms act as architecture: a place for stories, observations, and new perspectives.
The system pairs a warm two-colour palette with an open grid. This self-initiated demonstration has no real client or commercial affiliation.

gallery.alt: Common Ground publication cover with oversized typographic composition
Common Ground spread showing intersecting paths and an editorial text grid

projects.title: After Hours
projects.summary: An exercise in rhythm and contrast. A graphic series for the moments between one day and the next.

cover.alt: After Hours graphic study: electric blue circles and cream typography

description: A graphic series inspired by the change of pace after sunset. Repeated circles create a sense of rhythm without depending on photography.
Each composition uses the same few elements in a new arrangement. This is original sample artwork, not a real event or commissioned campaign.

gallery.alt: After Hours typographic poster with concentric blue circles
Companion After Hours composition with a blue disk and offset cream rings
